title: Implement in-topic group-name filtering for received messages
description:
Implement a filter layer that receives raw gossipsub messages on a hierarchy topic and dispatches only to handlers subscribed to the specific group named in the message's group_name field. Messages for groups the local node doesn't serve are dropped without processing. Artifact: transit/src/gossip/filter.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Messages for subscribed groups are dispatched to the correct handler
- Messages for unsubscribed groups on the same hierarchy topic are dropped (no error)
- Filter is applied before any log or IPFS operation
- Unit test: inject 100 messages for 10 groups, verify each handler receives only its own
